reviews.title: Idioma
reviews.text: Hay Laguna forma de cambiar la información a español? Todo está en inglés
reviews.reply:
Hi User,  
  
We greatly appreciate your time to leave us a review.  
  
We regret to hear that your expectations weren`t met. Thank you for giving us the chance to improve and serve you better.  
  
Let us advise you that the available languages are Spanish, English, Chinese, Portuguese, French, and Japanese. If you want to change to the one from the list, you need to change the language on your phone. In order to make it on your iPhone, open Settings → General → Language & Region In the list of Preferred languages, orders place the wanted language higher than the current one.  
  
Should you have any additional inquiries, don`t hesitate to email us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com. We`ll do everything we can to help and ensure your satisfaction.  
  
Sending positive vibes your way, Nebula team 🔮
